drop: Drop a DOC or compatible WPS document here to convert it to PDF
privacy: Your document stays in this browser. No uploads or remote content.
invalid: Choose a readable Word 97–2003 DOC or compatible WPS / WPT file. The file may be damaged or use an unsupported variant.
failed: The PDF could not be created. No incomplete file is available for download.
unsupported: This file contains content that cannot be exported completely, such as automatic numbering, notes, headers, text boxes, or unsupported images. Export it from its original Office application instead.
resource: The browser could not allocate enough resources to render this document. Close other tabs or try another device.
engineUnavailable: The conversion engine could not start. Reload the page or try a current browser.
fidelity: Supported body text, tables, and embedded images are reflowed onto A4 portrait pages with 18 mm margins, then rendered as image pages at 150 DPI.
limitations: Text is not selectable and OCR is not added. Files with detected automatic numbering, headers, footers, notes, comments, text boxes, or unsupported objects are rejected. Macros, interactive links, and digital signatures are not preserved or verified.
protected: Password-protected documents are not supported. Save an unencrypted copy in your Office application and try again.
layoutNotice: This is a reflowed copy, not the original page layout. Fonts, page count, and spacing may differ. Saved field text and the final revision view are used. Check every page before downloading.
